humanRationale: genre and atmosphere may suggest something supernatural, but they do not authorize a specific fiction-reality mechanic.
materialIssues: “the line between a bestselling horror writer's fiction and the physical world begins to blur,” “the author's books seems to be bleeding into reality,” “reality-warping horror,” and “reality-bending terror” resolve the authorized overview’s deliberately open statement that the books have an impact “far more than inspirational” into a specific fiction–reality crossover mechanic that the source does not establish, narrowing the central mystery and implying a later supernatural development.
